import os, sys, tempfile, threading, time, collections
from pathlib import Path
import delegate_agent.private_io as m
from delegate_agent.private_io import read_private_text_bounded, BoundedReadError
assert m.__file__.startswith("/tmp/adjSR/"), m.__file__

def run(sleep, reads=20000, label=""):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        path = Path(tmp) / "record.json"
        path.write_text('{"value": 0}\n', encoding="utf-8")
        stop = threading.Event(); st = threading.Event(); rp = threading.Event(); w = [0]
        def writer():
            st.set()
            while not stop.is_set():
                c = Path(tmp) / f".replacement-{w[0]}"
                c.write_text('{"value": %d}\n' % (w[0] % 2), encoding="utf-8")
                os.replace(c, path); w[0] += 1; rp.set()
                if sleep >= 0: time.sleep(sleep)
        t = threading.Thread(target=writer); t.start(); st.wait(2); rp.wait(2)
        cnt = collections.Counter()
        for _ in range(reads):
            try:
                text = read_private_text_bounded(path, max_bytes=1024)
                assert '"value":' in text
            except BoundedReadError as e:
                cnt[e.reason] += 1
        stop.set(); t.join(5)
        print(f"{label} sleep={sleep} module={os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(m.__file__))} "
              f"writes={w[0]} reads={reads} errors={dict(cnt) or 'NONE'}", flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sleep = float(sys.argv[1]); n = int(sys.argv[2]); label = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else ""
    run(sleep, n, label)
PYEOF
